Ziekket: [차단] Before the rez, interrupt the Lasher's Lightspore Shot with Quell, and knock up grouped Lashers with Tail Swipe to stop their casts

351338.d: 적의 주문 시전을 방해하고 6초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하도록 만듭니다.

355913.m: 3 정수 / 15% (기본 마나 중) · 25 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
355913.d: 대상 아군의 위치에 에메랄드의 꿈의 구근을 자라나게 합니다. 1.5초 후에 10미터 내에 있는 최대 3명의 부상당한 아군을 (주문력의 323%)만큼 치유합니다.

357208.m: 1.8% (기본 마나 중) · 집중 (2.5 초 주문 시전 시간) · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
357208.d:
숨을 들이쉬면서 내면의 불꽃을 지핍니다. 숨 방출 시 전방 부채꼴 범위 내의 적을 불태워 [((주문력의 163.409%)) + ((주문력의 39.4834%) * (10 + 0 + 0))]의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다. [시간의 모래: 활성화된 칠흑의 힘 효과의 지속시간이 2초만큼 증가합니다]

강화 시 지속 피해가 아닌 즉시 피해가 증가합니다.

I: 즉시 [(주문력의 163.409%)]의 피해를 입히고 (20 + 0 + 0)초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 39.4834%) * (10 + 0 + 0)]의 피해를 입힙니다.

II: 즉시 [(주문력의 163.409%) + ((주문력의 39.4834%) * 3)]의 피해를 입히고 (14 + 0 + 0)초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 39.4834%) * (7 + 0 + 0)]의 피해를 입힙니다.

III: 즉시 [(주문력의 163.409%) + ((주문력의 39.4834%) * 6)]의 피해를 입히고 (8 + 0 + 0)초에 걸쳐 [(주문력의 39.4834%) * (4 + 0 + 0)]의 피해를 입힙니다.

357214.d: 날개를 힘껏 펄럭여 전방의 적을 밀쳐냅니다.

358267.m: 즉시 · 35 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
358267.d:
도약하여 (6 + 0)초 동안 이동 속도가 30%만큼 증가합니다.

이동하면서 기원사 주문을 시전할 수 있으며, 시전 중에도 시전할 수 있습니다. 강화된 주문에는 영향을 주지 않습니다.

358385.m: 특성 · 1.4% (기본 마나 중) · 10 - 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
358385.d: 대상 위치를 향해 변화하는 돌의 길을 창조해 적을 15초 동안 이동 불가 상태로 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 받으면 효과가 해제될 수 있습니다.

360806.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 25 야드 사정거리 · 1.7 초 주문 시전 시간
360806.d: 적이 20초 동안 방향 감각을 상실하고 잠에 빠져 자신을 향해 다가오게 합니다. 피해를 받으면 일정 확률로 잠에서 깨어납니다.

360995.m: 특성 · 10% (기본 마나 중) · 25 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 24 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
360995.d: 아군에게 날아가 (주문력의 1719%)의 생명력을 회복시키거나, 자신의 생명력을 동일한 양만큼 회복시킵니다.

361227.m: 0.8% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 10 초 주문 시전 시간
361227.d: 죽은 파티원을 되살립니다. 대상은 35%의 생명력과 마나를 지닌 채로 되살아납니다. 전투 중에는 사용할 수 없습니다.

361469.m: 12% (기본 마나 중) · 25 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간
361469.d: 대상에게 명멸하는 불꽃을 보내 적에게 (주문력의 232.001%)의 화염 피해를 입히거나 아군을 (주문력의 780%)만큼 치유합니다.

362969.d: 2명의 적에게 강렬한 마력을 투사하여 (주문력의 163.185%)의 비전냉기 피해를 입힙니다.

363916.m: 특성 · 300 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
363916.d: 비늘을 강화해 받는 피해가 30%만큼 감소합니다. [소생의 불길: 추가로 8초에 걸쳐 방지한 피해만큼 생명력을 회복합니다] 12초 동안 지속됩니다.

364342.m: 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
364342.d: 시간의 실타래를 엮어 1시간 동안 모든 파티원과 공격대원의 주요 이동 능력의 재사용 대기시간을 15%만큼 감소시킵니다.

365585.m: 특성 · 10% (기본 마나 중) · 25 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간
365585.d: 아군이 받은 독을 없애며 모든 독 효과를 제거합니다.

368970.d: 꼬리를 휘둘러 8미터 내에 있는 적을 공중으로 날려 보냅니다.

369459.d: 아군 치유 담당에게 1시간 동안 남은 마력을 전달합니다. 강화된 주문을 시전할 때 강화 단계당 대상의 최대 마나를 0.25%만큼 회복시킵니다. 대상은 하나로 제한됩니다.

369939.d: 불의 숨결 시전 시 다음 살아있는 불꽃이 강화 단계 당 1명의 추가 대상에게 적용됩니다.

370553.d: 시간을 압축합니다. 다음 강화된 주문은 최대 강화 단계가 되며 즉시 시전됩니다.

370665.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
370665.d: 아군에게 강하하여 대상 위치까지 함께 비행합니다. 자신과 아군에게 걸린 이동 방해 효과를 제거합니다.

371032.d: [영겁의 숨결 / 깊은 숨결]이 적을 3초 동안 기절시킵니다.

374227.d: 상승 기류를 일으켜 자신 및 20미터 내의 가장 가까운 아군 4명을 공중으로 띄워 올립니다. 공중에 뜬 동안 8초 동안 광역 공격으로 받는 피해가 20%만큼 감소하고 이동 속도는 30%만큼 증가합니다.

374251.m: 특성 · 10% (기본 마나 중) · 25 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
374251.d: 아군의 상처를 소작해 모든 출혈, 독, 저주, 질병 효과를 제거합니다. 효과를 제거한 후 (주문력의 350%)만큼 치유합니다.

374348.d: 흑요석 비늘 사용 시 소생의 불길로 감싸여, 방지한 피해의 100%만큼 8초에 걸쳐 회복합니다.

390386.m: 4% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 5 분 재사용 대기시간
390386.d:
40초 동안 모든 파티원과 공격대원의 가속을 30%만큼 증가시킵니다.

효과를 받은 대상은 기력 소진 상태가 되어 10분 동안 위상의 격노 효과를 받지 못합니다.

395152.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
395152.d:
10초 동안 모든 공격 담당 아군의 주 능력치가 자신의 주 능력치의 (8 + 0)%만큼, 자신의 공격력은 20%만큼 증가합니다.

칠흑의 힘은 2명이 넘는 다른 아군에게 부여되면 효과가 분산됩니다.

분출, [영겁의 숨결 / 깊은 숨결], 강화 주문은 이 효과의 지속시간을 연장시킵니다.

395160.m: 특성 · 3 정수 · 25 야드 사정거리 · 2.5 초 주문 시전 시간
395160.d: 적의 발밑에 격렬한 분출을 일으켜 대상과 주위의 적에게 (주문력의 322%)의 화산 피해를 나누어 입힙니다. [시간의 모래: 활성화된 칠흑의 힘 효과의 지속시간이 1.0초만큼 증가합니다]

396187.d: 살아있는 불꽃 시전 시 20%의 확률로, 또한 하늘빛 일격 사용 시 15%의 확률로 다음 분출 [봄의 꿈: 또는 에메랄드 꽃]이 정수를 소모하지 않습니다. [정수의 조화: 1번까지 중첩됩니다]

396286.m: 특성 · 25 야드 사정거리 · 집중 (2.5 초 주문 시전 시간) · 40 초 재사용 대기시간
396286.d:
적의 발밑에 대지의 힘을 응집한 후 공중으로 날려 보내고, 대상과 주위의 적에게 (주문력의 602%)의 화산 피해를 입힙니다. [시간의 모래: 활성화된 칠흑의 힘 효과의 지속시간이 2초만큼 증가합니다]

강화 시 효과 범위가 확장됩니다.

I: 반경이 3미터가 됩니다.

II: 반경이 6미터가 됩니다.

III: 반경이 9미터가 됩니다.

403631.m: 특성 · 15 - 50 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
403631.d:
대상 위치로 날아가 10초 동안 이동 경로에 있는 적의 시간의 상처를 노출시킵니다. [시간의 모래: 추가로 5초 동안 칠흑의 힘이 부여됩니다]

이동 불가 효과를 제거하고 비행 중에는 이동 방해 및 제어 불가 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

시간의 상처
칠흑의 힘에 영향을 받는 아군이 입힌 피해의 15%를 복제하여 10초 후에 적에게 추가 비전 피해로 입힙니다.

칠흑의 힘이 다른 2명이 넘는 아군에게 영향을 주면 공격력이 감소합니다.

404195.d:
죽음에 이르는 치명적인 공격을 받으면 근처 시간의 길로 흘려보내, 현재 시간의 길에서의 피해와 죽음을 방지합니다.

시간의 마력을 방출하면 자신은 [(주문력의 750%) * (3)]의 생명력을 회복하고 주위 4명의 아군을 9초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 750%)만큼 치유합니다. 치유량은 시간이 지날수록 점차 줄어듭니다.

6분에 한 번씩만 발동합니다.

404977.m: 특성 · 집중 (2 초 주문 시전 시간) · 3 분 재사용 대기시간
404977.d: 시간이 쇄도하여 2초 동안 재사용 대기시간 회복 속도가 1000%만큼 증가합니다.

406732.m: 특성 · 60 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 3 분 재사용 대기시간
406732.d:
자신과 아군 치유 담당에게 역설을 일으켜 이동하면서 주문을 시전할 수 있도록 만들고 10초 동안 거의 모든 주문의 사정거리를 100%만큼 증가시킵니다.

대상 치유 담당을 지정하지 않을 경우 60미터 내의 가장 가까운 치유 담당에게 영향을 줍니다.

409267.d: 분출 시전 시 25%의 확률로 주위에 전환된 정수의 티끌을 형성합니다. 아군이 이 티끌을 통과하면 무작위 강화 효과를 얻습니다. (효과 발동 확률: 25%)

409311.m: 특성 · 25 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 12 초 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
409311.d:
아군에게 선견지명의 선물을 부여하여 치명타 및 극대화율을 3%만큼 증가시킵니다. [운명의 거울: 또한 일정 확률로 공격 및 치유 주문을 15%의 효율로 복제합니다] 18초 동안 지속됩니다.

아군 대상을 지정하지 않을 경우 25미터 내의 가장 가까운 재사용 대기시간이 활성화된 공격 담당 아군에게 우선적으로 영향을 줍니다.

412774.d: 예지의 영향을 받는 아군은 주문 및 능력 사용 시 일정 확률로 피해량 또는 치유량이 메아리쳐 15%만큼 다시 피해를 입히거나 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

413525.d:
분출 [봄의 꿈: 또는 에메랄드 꽃]시전 시 활성화된 칠흑의 힘 효과의 지속시간이 1초만큼 증가합니다.

강화 주문 시전 시 활성화된 칠흑의 힘 효과의 지속시간이 2초만큼 증가합니다.

[영겁의 숨결: 영겁의 숨결 / 깊은 숨결] 시전 시 활성화된 칠흑의 힘 효과의 지속시간이 5초만큼 증가합니다.

이 효과는 일정 확률로 치명타 및 극대화 효과를 발휘하며, 칠흑의 힘의 지속시간을 추가로 50%만큼 증가시킵니다.

413984.d:
강화 주문 시전 시 1명의 아군에게 흐르는 모래를 부여합니다. 공격 담당에게 우선적으로 부여되며, 10초 동안 유연성을 2.0%만큼 증가시킵니다.

흐르는 모래, 영겁의 숨결, 기타 유용한 오라의 지속시간이 4.0%만큼 증가합니다.

429483.d:
부양 시전 시 일시적으로 공간을 왜곡해 목표 지점에서 나타납니다. 추가로 부양의 재사용 대기시간이 5초만큼 감소합니다.

부양으로 이동하는 동안 기원사 주문을 시전할 수 있습니다.

431442.d: 살아있는 불꽃이 청동 마법으로 강화되어, 지난 5초 동안 대상에게 입힌 피해 또는 치유량을 25%만큼, 최대 [(주문력 * 2.5) * (1 + 유연성)]만큼 비전 효과로 반복 적용합니다.

431695.d: 전세역전의 효과로 시간의 마력이 과부하되어 가속과 이동 속도, 재사용 대기시간 회복 속도가 30%만큼 증가합니다. 이 효과는 30초에 걸쳐 점점 감소합니다.

431874.d: 칠흑의 힘과 예지가 시전자의 치명타 및 극대화율에 해당하는 확률로 능력치를 추가로 50%만큼 증가시킵니다. 칠흑의 힘의 경우, 이 증가 효과가 15.0초 동안 지속됩니다.

433871.d:
깊은 숨결을 원하는 방향으로 조정할 수 있습니다.

추가로 깊은 숨결이 대상을 불태워 12초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 840%)의 화산 피해를 입힙니다.

434300.d:
대규모 분출 시전 시 다음 6초 동안 주 대상에게 파괴의 징표를 남깁니다.

자신과 아군이 징표에 걸린 대상을 공격할 때 일정 확률로 폭격을 발동시켜 주위의 모든 적에게 [$INT * 4.75 * (1 + 유연성) * 공격력 백분율 * 1]의 화산 피해를 고르게 나누어 입힙니다.

438587.d: 강화 주문 시전 시 다음 분출이 최대 3명의 대상을 가격합니다. 3명 미만의 대상을 가격할 경우 최대치에서 부족한 대상 한 명당 분출의 공격력이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

441206.d: 대규모 분출 시전 시 적중한 대상 하나당 영겁의 숨결의 남은 재사용 대기시간이 1.5초만큼 감소합니다.

1259173.d: 영겁의 숨결 시전 시 미래에서 자신을 불러내 20초 동안 전투를 돕게 합니다. 시전자의 복제는 분출, 불의 숨결, 지각 변동을 시전합니다.

1: [참고] If you are the Bloodlust provider, press Fury of the Aspects (5 min, 30% party haste for 40 sec) once everything is stacked, then apply Ebon Might and fly Breath of Eons (2 min) through the pack. Terror of the Skies stuns enemies in the path for 3 sec, which also stops Radiant Spellsower casts.

[차단] Put Quell (20 sec) into the kick rotation for Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy). Quell only has 25 yd range, so stand close to the Spellsower as it walks toward the tank.
[광역 피해] Pop Zephyr (2 min) when Sporeblight Belcher starts Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec). For 8 sec you and 4 allies within 20 yds take 20% less area-of-effect damage (Wowhead).
2: [차단] If both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley together, Quell one and knock up both next to the tank with Tail Swipe (1 min with Clobbering Sweep, 8 yd knock-up). Upheaval (40 sec) also launches its targets, so it can stop a leftover cast while dealing damage (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] If the Zephyr from pull 1 is not back yet, take Spouting Floret with Obsidian Scales (1.5 min, 2 charges with Obsidian Bulwark). It reduces damage taken by 30% for 12 sec, and Renewing Blaze heals back the prevented damage over 8 sec.
3: [제어] When a Radiant Spellsower runs to a dormant Lasher pack with Call The Grove, block its path with Landslide (1.5 min) to root it for 15 sec, or put it to sleep with Sleep Walk (1.7 sec cast, 20 sec disorient) so it walks toward you.
[광역 피해] Virid Grovekeeper's Uproot (3 sec cast, 116379 Nature plus knockback) is area damage that Zephyr reduces (Wowhead). If Zephyr is back, pop it on the cast.
5: [차단] Put Quell into the kick rotation for Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec disorient) (Wowhead).

[제어] When Thorny Saptor jumps in with Thornclaw Leap, knock it up with Tail Swipe to stop the cone attacks that follow. If Breath of Eons is ready, fly it through the Saptor so Terror of the Skies stuns it for 3 sec.
[광역 피해] Sporeblight Belcher is pulled first, so pop Zephyr for Spouting Floret, then take Uproot from the Virid Grovekeeper that joins 5-6 sec later with Obsidian Scales.
7: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Quell. If Quell is on cooldown, put the Petalwing to sleep with Sleep Walk to stop the cast (Wowhead: it works as a backup interrupt on non-Lieutenant enemies).
[제어] Knock up both Thorny Saptors with Tail Swipe to stop Thornclaw Leap. If Tail Swipe (1 min) is still on cooldown from pull 5, use the 3 sec stun from Breath of Eons (Terror of the Skies) instead.

[회피] When the two Luminous Thornmaws cast Solar Breath (3 sec cast, 387930 Holy frontal cone), use Hover (35 sec) and leave the cone. Hover lets you keep casting Eruption while moving, but empowered spells (Fire Breath, Upheaval) still require standing still.
8: [제어] Knock up both Thorny Saptors with Tail Swipe to stop Thornclaw Leap.
[광역 피해] Pop Zephyr for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and take it with Obsidian Scales if Zephyr is on cooldown.
10: [해제] Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew (67888 Nature plus a poison dealing 58189 Nature every 1.5 sec for 9 sec) hits the whole party. Clear the lowest-health player first with Expunge (8 sec), and the second player with Cauterizing Flame (1 min) (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] Pop Zephyr when you see the Toxic Spew cast (2 sec) to reduce the initial hit.
[참고] Breath of Eons' Temporal Wound releases its copied damage after 10 sec, so always include the long-lived Potatoad Matriarch in the path rather than Lashers about to die.
11: [차단] A single Quell cannot stop all three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech. If the tank has them grouped, knock them up together with Tail Swipe and Quell the remaining one.
[광역 피해] Use Zephyr or Obsidian Scales for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret. If Luminous Thornmaw's Solar Breath overlaps, leave the cone with Hover.
12: [참고] This is the last big pull, so when Breath of Eons, Upheaval, Fire Breath and Prescience are all on cooldown, use Time Skip (3 min, cooldowns recover 1000% faster for 2 sec) to cycle your cooldowns once more (Wowhead).

[차단] Split the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley between Quell and Tail Swipe. Lightgorged Lashers shielded by Lightbloom Pollination are immune to crowd control, so aim Tail Swipe at the Spellsowers.
[광역 피해] If Spouting Floret and Light Bolt Volley overlap, use Zephyr and Obsidian Scales together.

1: [차단] The two Primal Serpents need one interrupter each. Take one Serpent's Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 Physical and 30% reduced haste for 6 sec) with Quell (20 sec). Quell only has 25 yd range, so stand close to that Serpent.

[제어] Ravenous Claws attack speed stacks on the seven Ravenous Descendants only last 2 sec after the last swing. When the tank starts taking heavy damage, fly Breath of Eons (2 min) through the Descendants so Terror of the Skies stuns them for 3 sec and drops the stacks.
[회피] For Twinfang Harrower's Toxic Breath (3 sec cast, frontal spray of 67888 Nature every 0.5 sec), use Hover (35 sec) to step sideways and keep casting Eruption.
2: [광역 피해] Ritual Chieftain's Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole party and absorbs the next 162029 healing) is the most painful hit in this area. Press Obsidian Scales (1.5 min, 2 charges with Obsidian Bulwark) to take 30% less damage for 12 sec (Topicx: use defensives here).
[우선 처치] The Ritual Chieftain dies first, so always include it in the path if Breath of Eons is ready. Temporal Wound adds 15% of the damage from allies with Ebon Might to the Chieftain after 10 sec.
[차단] Kick Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Quell.
3: [차단] When the tank breaks line of sight behind the pillar, the three Primal Serpents walk down and group up. Quell one Piercing Hiss and knock up the rest together with Tail Swipe (1 min with Clobbering Sweep, 8 yd knock-up) to stop their casts.
[광역 피해] Use your remaining Obsidian Scales charge for Blood Sacrifice. If you spent both charges in pull 2, press Zephyr (2 min) instead.
5: [참고] At 103 trash count this is the biggest pull of the route. Apply Ebon Might, then fly Breath of Eons where the two Twinfang Harrowers and the Ritual Chieftain overlap. A path that only crosses dying Venom Leeches wastes the 10 sec Temporal Wound damage.

[광역 피해] Press Zephyr for Blood Sacrifice so you and 4 allies within 20 yds take 20% less area damage for 8 sec, and add Obsidian Scales for yourself. Players stacking Paralyzing Shots DoTs (48491 Nature every sec for 20 sec) make this the heaviest healing moment (Topicx).
[회피] Leave the Toxic Breath frontals from both Twinfang Harrowers with Hover.
7: [차단] If High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) lands right before Rattling Writhe's Rattle, the DoT and the AoE overlap. Save Quell for this cast and always kick it (Topicx).

[해제] When Envenom poison (24246 Nature every sec for 8 sec) hits two or more players, clear the first with Expunge (8 sec) and the second with Cauterizing Flame (1 min). Clear the poison that landed right before Rattle first.
[광역 피해] Press Zephyr for Rattle (58189 Physical every sec for 5 sec, ignores armor). If Zephyr is on cooldown, take it with Obsidian Scales.
8: [제어] The four Bloodletters leave a blood pool on every melee swing. Once the tank groups them, fly Breath of Eons through them so Terror of the Skies stuns them for 3 sec, and if Breath of Eons is on cooldown, knock them up with Tail Swipe to stop their swings.
[광역 피해] Use Zephyr or Obsidian Scales for Rattle.
9: [제어] One ranged player has to bring in the far left High Evolutionist (Topicx). Move within 25 yds and cast Sleep Walk (1.7 sec cast, 20 sec disorient) so that Evolutionist stops casting and walks toward you. Wake it with damage once it reaches the tank.
[차단] Take one of the two Evolutionists' Mass Envenom with Quell, and aim Upheaval (40 sec) at the Evolutionists so they die before the second Mass Envenom.
[해제] Clear Envenom with Expunge, and use Cauterizing Flame on the second player if two are poisoned at once.
11: [차단] When the group assigns a kicker to each of the four High Evolutionists, take one Evolutionist's Mass Envenom with Quell.

[제어] Stop the Evolve channel (6 sec) with a stun (Topicx). If grouped Evolutionists start Evolve, fly Breath of Eons through them for a 3 sec stun, or knock them up with Tail Swipe if Breath of Eons is on cooldown. A finished cast grants a 250045 shield and crowd control immunity.
[해제] Four Evolutionists keep applying Envenom, so press Expunge on cooldown (8 sec) and clear the lowest-health player first.
12: [참고] The Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest (Topicx). Refresh Ebon Might and line up Breath of Eons on the Serpent to focus party damage on the miniboss.

[광역 피해] During Infest (34914 Nature every sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yds) the party stacks on the tank's marked spot and the bursts overlap. Press Zephyr as everyone stacks so 4 allies within 20 yds are covered.
[회피] Dodge Virulent Whirl (2 sec cast, 290947 Nature within 6 yds of each impact) and the leftover twisters with Hover while you keep casting Eruption.
13: [우선 처치] Breath of Eons' Temporal Wound adds damage to every enemy in its path after 10 sec. If the six Living Venoms are in the path they die together and their Venom Bursts stack, so fly only through Ula'tek's Chosen (Topicx: kill them in small groups). Empower Upheaval only to rank 1 so it launches just the area around the Chosen.
[차단] Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom must be kicked every time, so put Quell into the kick rotation.
[광역 피해] Press Zephyr when Toxic Surge starts (2 sec cast, 29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec), and dodge the Toxic Beam lines (339438 Nature) that follow with Hover.
14: [제어] Blade of the Altar must be stunned during Toxic Surge (Topicx). If Breath of Eons is ready, fly only through Ula'tek's Chosen and the two Blades so Terror of the Skies stuns them for 3 sec, and keep the Living Venoms out of the path.
[광역 피해] If the Zephyr (2 min) from pull 13 is not back, take Toxic Surge with Obsidian Scales.
[차단] Kick Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom with Quell.
15: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Quell. If the player on the other Serpent misses, knock it up with Tail Swipe.
[회피] Leave Twinfang Harrower's Toxic Breath frontal with Hover.
16: [참고] This is the last trash pull and the heaviest healing load. When Breath of Eons, Upheaval and Fire Breath are all on cooldown, cycle them again with Time Skip (3 min, cooldowns recover 1000% faster for 2 sec) and kill Ula'tek's Chosen before the second Toxic Surge (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Split the two Obsidian Scales charges across the back-to-back Blood Sacrifices from the two Ritual Chieftains, and press Zephyr for Toxic Surge.
[차단] Kick Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom with Quell every time.

1: [참고] This Bloodlust pull takes the Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together (Topicx). If you provide Bloodlust, press Fury of the Aspects (5 min, 30% party haste for 40 sec), apply Ebon Might, then line up Breath of Eons (2 min) on the Captain, which dies first.

[해제] Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison stacks (193965 Nature over 8 sec, 5% max health reduction per stack) build on the tank first. Press Expunge (8 sec) on the tank on cooldown (Topicx: assign a poison dispeller).

[해제] Cauterizing Flame (1 min) removes Row Hooligan's Cutpurse bleed (38793 Physical plus 155172 Bleed over 8 sec) and the Captain's Glaive Toss bleed. Clear players with both a bleed and the poison first.
2: [차단] The only must-kick is Seductive Sayaad's Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient), one player per Sayaad (Topicx). Take one with Quell (20 sec), and if Quell is on cooldown, put it to sleep with Sleep Walk (1.7 sec cast) to stop the cast.
[회피] The four Felwyrms explode for 4 yd Fel Detonation (193965 Fire) on death, so leave with Hover (35 sec) while you keep casting.
3: [차단] Kick one of the two Felonious Mages' Fel Missiles channel with Quell.
[해제] If Row Hooligan's Cutpurse bleed overlaps with other debuffs, remove it with Cauterizing Flame.
4: [해제] Four Street Sneaks stack Heartstop Poison quickly (Topicx). Clear the tank with Expunge on cooldown and the second poisoned player with Cauterizing Flame.
[차단] Kick Felonious Mage's Fel Missiles with Quell.
5: [우선 처치] Kill the Massive Felwyrm first (Topicx). Refresh Ebon Might and put Upheaval (40 sec) on the Massive Felwyrm.

[광역 피해] While the Massive Felwyrm lives, Over-infused triggers Burning Fel (38793 Fire within 50 yds) every 3 sec. When health gets low, press Zephyr (2 min) so you and 4 allies within 20 yds take 20% less area damage for 8 sec.
[회피] Avoid Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yds) by leaving 10 yds with Hover.
8: [차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% damage reduction and crowd control immunity for 1 min). Augmentation cannot remove Enrage, so save Quell for this cast. Fel Invoker's Health Funnel comes next.
[참고] Below 50% Shivan Punisher enters Demonic Frenzy and pulses 29095 Fire every sec until it dies. At 50%, line up Breath of Eons on the Punisher so it dies quickly.
[회피] Leave 12 yds with Hover for Shivan Punisher's Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 290947 Physical within 12 yds) while you keep casting Eruption.
9: [해제] Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom (581895 Shadow after 10.1 sec) is a Curse, so remove it immediately with Cauterizing Flame (Topicx: dispel the curse right away).
[참고] If you are the Drain Life target, press Obsidian Scales (1.5 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec). Without a defensive the warlock heals a lot (Topicx).
[차단] Kick one of the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Quell.
10: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel (30 sec channel, heals its target for 10% max health every 2 sec) with Quell (Topicx).
[참고] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, refresh Ebon Might and line up Breath of Eons on it (Topicx: focus it then).
11: [참고] Felmaster Lucsei must die before Blade Dance comes out more than three times (Topicx). Apply Ebon Might and line up Breath of Eons on Lucsei.
[광역 피해] Split personal and party defensives across Blade Dance (2 sec cast, repeated 43642 Fire hits on everyone) (Topicx). Press Zephyr for the first and Obsidian Scales for the second.
[회피] Step sideways out of the party with Hover for Eye Beam (2.5 sec cast, 38793 Chaos frontal).
13: [광역 피해] Party defensives go on Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (2 sec cast, 145474 Fire to everyone) (Topicx). Press Zephyr for the first Slam.
[회피] Dodge Fel Beam (96982 Fire every sec) by walking backward with Hover (Topicx). You can keep casting Eruption during Hover.
[차단] Kick one of the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Quell.
14: [차단] Split the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage between Quell and Tail Swipe (1 min with Clobbering Sweep, 8 yd knock-up). Leave Fel Invoker's Health Funnel to the group's remaining interrupts.
15: [해제] Pull the Corrupted Warlock back and kill it first (Topicx). Remove Curse of Doom immediately with Cauterizing Flame.
[참고] Press Obsidian Scales if you are the Drain Life target.
[참고] When the Shivan Punisher is pulled separately, line up Breath of Eons below 50% to shorten Demonic Frenzy.
16: [광역 피해] Finish the Defiled Golem within two AoEs and assign two party defensives (Topicx). Press Zephyr for the first Defiled Slam and Obsidian Scales for the second.

[참고] This is the last trash pull. When Breath of Eons, Upheaval and Fire Breath are all on cooldown, cycle them again with Time Skip (3 min, cooldowns recover 1000% faster for 2 sec) so the Golem dies within the second Slam.
[차단] Kick one of the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel with Quell.

1: [참고] This is the first Bloodlust pull (Topicx). If you provide Bloodlust, press Fury of the Aspects (5 min, 30% party haste for 40 sec) once everything is stacked, apply Ebon Might, then fly Breath of Eons (2 min) across the Spirit of Hunger and both Territorial Matriarchs.
[해제] Spirit of Hunger's Insatiable Hunger (6 sec cast, stacking 15% max health reduction) is a Curse, so Cauterizing Flame (1 min) can remove it. Clear players at 2 stacks first.

[해제] When the three Keen-Eyed Strikers dive in with Razor Dive and stack bleeds (33944 Physical every sec for 10 sec), remove the bleed from the player with the most stacks with Cauterizing Flame. If you already spent it on the Curse, survive with Obsidian Scales (1.5 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec).
2: [차단] Put Quell (20 sec) into the kick rotation for Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast, heals nearby allies for 5% max health every 2 sec) and Earth Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature). Kick Healing Breeze first.
[해제] Clear the Insatiable Hunger Curse with Cauterizing Flame before it reaches 2 stacks. Put Upheaval (40 sec) around the Starvation Effigy totem so it dies first.
3: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Quell.
[광역 피해] Press Zephyr (2 min) for Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery (drains 38793 Shadow from everyone every sec for 5 sec). You and 4 allies within 20 yds take 20% less area damage for 8 sec.
4: [해제] When Razor Dive bleeds from the three Keen-Eyed Strikers stack on one player, remove them with Cauterizing Flame. If the same player also has Insatiable Hunger, both are cleared at once.
[광역 피해] If the Feast of Misery channel overlaps with 2 stacks of Insatiable Hunger, press Obsidian Scales (Topicx: the overlap is dangerous).
7: [참고] This is the cooldown pull after the boss (Topicx). Refresh Ebon Might and fly Breath of Eons over both Territorial Matriarchs and the Earthwhisper Tenders.
[차단] Take one of the two Earthwhisper Tenders' Healing Breeze with Quell, and if the other casts at the same time, knock it up with Tail Swipe (1 min with Clobbering Sweep, 8 yd knock-up).
[해제] Remove Keen-Eyed Striker's Razor Dive bleed with Cauterizing Flame.
8: [우선 처치] While Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield is up it pulses 24246 Nature to everyone every 2 sec. Keep Prescience on two damage dealers and put Upheaval on the Rumbler so the shield breaks quickly.
9: [참고] This is the second Bloodlust pull (Topicx). If you provide Bloodlust, press Fury of the Aspects and fly Breath of Eons over both Frigid Maulers and the Terra Rumbler. The 3 sec stun from Terror of the Skies also stops the Maulers' casts.
[차단] Frigid Mauler's Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, 50% reduced haste and movement speed on hit) has a long cast and is easy to kick. Put Quell into the kick rotation.
[위치] Glacial Revenant's Cryo Surge (48491 within 4 yds) is a Magic effect Augmentation cannot remove. If you are hit, use Hover (35 sec) to get more than 4 yds from the party while you keep casting.
10: [차단] Quell one of the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar, and if the other casts at the same time, knock it up with Tail Swipe.
[참고] This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust (Topicx). If the Breath of Eons from pull 9 is not back, focus Upheaval and Fire Breath on the stacked pack.
11: [우선 처치] Kill Avatar of Determination first (Topicx). Refresh Ebon Might and line up Breath of Eons on the Avatar. Terra Rumbler is next.
[회피] For the Avatar's Pulverize (4 sec cast, 387930 Physical and a 4 sec stun within 12 yds), use Hover to get out of 12 yds while you keep casting Eruption.
[광역 피해] Press Zephyr for Glacial Tomb (38793 Frost to everyone every 2 sec until broken), and stand stacked to break the tomb next to you.
13: [차단] Put Quell into the kick rotation for the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature to up to 3 players).
[광역 피해] Press Obsidian Scales when Grizzled Warbringer's Primal Echo (stacking armor-ignoring Physical within 60 yds) lands. In high keys this is where defensives go (Topicx).
[우선 처치] Break Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem first by launching the area around it with Upheaval.
14: [참고] This is a third Bloodlust candidate (Topicx). Only press Fury of the Aspects here, together with Breath of Eons, if you are not saving it for Loa Speaker Nanea in a high key.
[광역 피해] If both Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems (36368 Fire to everyone every 0.3 sec) overlap, press Zephyr and have the group kill the totems first (Topicx).
[차단] Kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Quell.
15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers alternate Primal Echo (Topicx). Use Obsidian Scales for the first Echo, Zephyr for the next, and your second Obsidian Scales charge from Obsidian Bulwark after that.
[차단] Take one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning with Quell.
[참고] At 85 trash count this is the biggest pull of the route. Apply Ebon Might and line up Breath of Eons on the Warbringer pack.
16: [차단] Put Quell into the kick rotation for Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt (2.5 sec cast).

[우선 처치] Volatile Totems must be finished before the third wave (Topicx). If Breath of Eons is ready, fly it through the totems and Nanea together so Temporal Wound damage hits both. In high keys press Fury of the Aspects here.
[회피] If you are targeted by Earthquake (4 sec cast), use Hover to get more than 10 yds away from the party before the zone drops.

1: [참고] This pull takes the first corridor up to the Voidtouched Magi at once and uses Bloodlust (Topicx). If you provide Bloodlust, press Fury of the Aspects (5 min, 30% party haste for 40 sec) once the Magi is pulled into the room, apply Ebon Might, then line up Breath of Eons (2 min) on the Magi.
[차단] The tank takes the first kick on Voidtouched Magi's Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yds). Take the second cast with Quell (20 sec) (Topicx).
[해제] Remove Feral Saberon's Savage Leap bleed (38793 Physical every sec for 5 sec) with Cauterizing Flame (1 min). Wowhead rates Cauterizing Flame as a must in this dungeon.
2: [광역 피해] Use defensives for Raj'kess the Spellstorm's long party-wide Thundering Storm (Topicx). Press Zephyr (2 min) when it starts, and add Obsidian Scales (1.5 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec) if it continues.

[우선 처치] If even one of the three Orbs of Disruption finishes its cast, party haste drops sharply (Topicx). Switch to the orbs immediately, and if they are grouped, stop their casts with Tail Swipe (1 min with Clobbering Sweep, 8 yd knock-up) and Upheaval.
[위치] Use Hover (35 sec) to stand apart from other players so Forked Lightning (2.5 sec cast, 77586 Nature bouncing to 2 more players) does not jump.
3: [광역 피해] Use a personal defensive for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (10 sec channel, 87284 Nature to everyone every 2 sec) (Topicx). Press Zephyr when the channel starts and take the second half with Obsidian Scales.
[참고] Burst when Brutok hits a wall and Concussion stuns it for 5 sec while it takes 20% more Physical damage (Topicx). Refresh Ebon Might and put Upheaval and Fire Breath into those 5 sec.
[해제] When Savage Leap bleeds from the five Feral Saberons stack on the tank, remove them with Cauterizing Flame (Topicx: in high keys use an external).
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yds) is the most important kick in this area (Topicx). Save Quell for this cast and leave Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt to someone else.

[광역 피해] Press Zephyr right before entering the circle of Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike (5 sec cast, 872842 Nature within 10 yds split among players hit). After the knock-up, leave the leftover whirlwind right away with Hover.
[참고] If you are targeted by Void Beam (2 sec cast, 43642 Shadow within 8 yds every 0.5 sec for 4 sec), leave the party with Hover while you keep casting.
6: [우선 처치] Break Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams shield quickly with damage cooldowns (Topicx). When the shield appears, refresh Ebon Might and line up Breath of Eons on the Overseer.
[광역 피해] When Brutal Slams (48491 Physical to everyone every 1.5 sec, 10% more per slam) ramps up, press Obsidian Scales, and add Zephyr if it overlaps with the Sky Strike soak.
[회피] Keep moving with Hover to avoid the Overseer's Macestorm (77586 Physical within 8 yds every sec for 6 sec) (Topicx).
8: [참고] Topicx uses damage cooldowns on this pull. Once the patrolling Devouring Brutalizer joins, refresh Ebon Might and line up Breath of Eons on the stacked pack.
[차단] Always kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Quell. Voidminder's Mending Void comes after it (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Press Zephyr for Devouring Brutalizer's Dreadbellow (4.5 sec cast, knockback and 29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec, cannot be dispelled).
9: [우선 처치] Kill the low-health mob targeted by Devouring Brutalizer's Devour (9 sec cast) before the cast ends (Topicx). Put Upheaval around that mob to launch it along with its neighbors.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Quell.
[광역 피해] Use Zephyr for Dreadbellow. If the Zephyr (2 min) from pull 8 is not back, take it with Obsidian Scales.
10: [참고] This is the last trash pull. When Breath of Eons, Upheaval and Fire Breath are all on cooldown, cycle them again with Time Skip (3 min, cooldowns recover 1000% faster for 2 sec) so the Watchful Harrower and Devouring Brutalizer die quickly.
[광역 피해] If Dreadbellow overlaps with the Sky Strike soak, press Zephyr and Obsidian Scales together.
[해제] Remove the two Feral Saberons' Savage Leap bleeds with Cauterizing Flame.

1: [참고] As the first pull of the dungeon, this pull uses Bloodlust (Topicx). If you provide Bloodlust, press Fury of the Aspects (5 min, 30% party haste for 40 sec) once the two Animated Guardians are dragged into the Shadow-Borne Champion pack, apply Ebon Might, then line up Breath of Eons (2 min) on the stacked pack.

[광역 피해] Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow within 100 yds) can one-shot you in high keys, so use a defensive on every cast (Topicx). Use Obsidian Scales (1.5 min, 2 charges with Obsidian Bulwark, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec) on the first cast, Zephyr (2 min) on the second, and the remaining Obsidian Scales charge on the third.
2: [차단] Kick Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow and a 12 sec curse DoT) with Quell (20 sec). Quell only has 25 yd range, so stand close to the Hexer.
[해제] Remove a missed Hex Volley curse with Cauterizing Flame (1 min). Wowhead rates Cauterizing Flame as a must in this dungeon.

[광역 피해] Topicx plays this pack separately as a cooldown pack. Use the Obsidian Scales charge or Zephyr left over from pull 1 for Shadow Whirlwind, refresh Ebon Might, and put Upheaval and Fire Breath into the Champion.
4: [참고] Do not dump cooldowns before the tank reaches the awakened pack and holds threat (Topicx). When the hardest pack, King A'akul with the Bloodsworn Assassins, wakes up and the tank has it, refresh Ebon Might and line up Breath of Eons on that pack.

[차단] Kick Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (2.5 sec cast, 10 sec mind control) with Quell first, and split Soul Bolt and Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending (heals 7% every 2 sec for 10 sec) with the other kickers.
[회피] If King Timalji's Bladestorm (moves toward its target, 164870 Physical every 0.5 sec) targets you, press Hover (35 sec) and run away while you keep casting Eruption.
5: [광역 피해] Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to everyone plus a zone) hits very hard and needs party defensives (Topicx). Press Zephyr on the first big hit and take the next one with Obsidian Scales.

[참고] In high keys or on a four-Bloodlust route, Bloodlust goes on this Construct on the bridge (Topicx). If your group plans that, press Fury of the Aspects and line up Ebon Might and Breath of Eons on the Construct.
[회피] Press Hover while backing out of the zones on the bridge so you can keep casting while you move.
6: [차단] Take one of the two Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast) kicks from the two Half-Finished Mummies with Quell (Topicx).
[해제] A missed cast puts a 12 sec disease (116379 Nature every 2 sec) on the whole party. Cauterizing Flame clears only one player, so clear the lowest-health player first.
7: [차단] On the other side, also take one of the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge with Quell.
[해제] Clear one player of a missed disease with Cauterizing Flame. If you used it in pull 6, check that its 1 min cooldown is back.
9: [우선 처치] Kill the two Spectral Shamans first so no more Healing Tide Totems come out (Topicx). Apply Ebon Might and fly Breath of Eons where the two Shamans overlap.

[차단] The two Phantom Hex Priests cast nonstop, so AoE stops are needed (Topicx). Kick Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec polymorph) with Quell, and if both are grouped, knock them up together with Tail Swipe (1 min with Clobbering Sweep, 8 yd knock-up) and Upheaval to stop their casts.
[해제] Free a player caught by Hex at once by removing the curse with Cauterizing Flame. The same spell also clears stacked Bloodthirsty Axe bleeds from Royal Berserkers.
10: [참고] On a four-Bloodlust route, the third Bloodlust goes on this pack on the bridge (Topicx). The Ghostly Brute dies first, so press Fury of the Aspects and line up Breath of Eons on the Brute.
[회피] Always avoid Ghostly Brute's Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby and a knock-up). Press Hover and get out while you keep casting.
[차단] Kick Phantom Hex Priest's Hex with Quell, and remove a missed Hex with Cauterizing Flame.
12: [위치] A ranged damage dealer or the healer soaks the far Pool of Darkness (Topicx). If you take it, press Obsidian Scales while standing in it. Topicx notes it hurts damage dealers and healers quite a bit.
[위치] If Dark Revelation (1.5 sec cast, 473120 Shadow within 20 yds after 5 sec) targets you, press Hover and move more than 20 yds away from the party.

1: [차단] Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield (15 sec channel, gives an ally an absorb shield and crowd control immunity every 3 sec) must be kicked (Topicx). Save Quell (20 sec) for this channel and leave Frostbolt to someone else.

[제어] Right after the pull, Tectonic Strike stacks (25% more damage taken, stacking) from the four Deepstone Earthshapers build on the tank. When the stacks get high, fly Breath of Eons (2 min) along a path where the Earthshapers and the Primal Juggernaut overlap so Terror of the Skies stuns the Earthshapers for 3 sec, and leave Temporal Wound on the Juggernaut that dies first (Topicx: drop stacks with stuns, Juggernaut first).

[광역 피해] Press Zephyr (2 min) for Primal Juggernaut's Excavating Blast (3.5 sec cast, 106681 Nature within 60 yds plus an 8 sec DoT), and dodge the Blast Chunks circles that follow with Hover (35 sec) while you keep casting.
2: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Quell.
[광역 피해] If Zephyr from pull 1 is not back, take Excavating Blast with Obsidian Scales (1.5 min, 2 charges with Obsidian Bulwark, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec).
3: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Quell. A mob that keeps the shield cannot be stunned.
[제어] When the two Deepstone Earthshapers' Tectonic Strike stacks get high, knock them up together with Tail Swipe (1 min with Clobbering Sweep, 8 yd knock-up) to stop their swings for a moment.
[참고] Defier Draghar is a crowd-control-immune miniboss. Refresh Ebon Might, put Upheaval and Fire Breath around Draghar, and line up Breath of Eons on Draghar if it is back.
5: [차단] Kicks go to Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Fire) first (Topicx). Take one Cinderweaver with Quell.

[제어] Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel, 96982 Fire and 242456 Physical every sec) cannot be interrupted and must be stopped with a stun (Topicx). If both Flamelashers are grouped, knock them up together with Tail Swipe, and knock up the last one with Upheaval.
[광역 피해] Use defensives when Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno party DoT hurts (Topicx). Press Zephyr, and if Living Bomb targets you, move more than 6 yds away from the party with Hover.
6: [참고] Below 50% Flamegullet's Molten Blood keeps increasing party damage, so kill it fast, and in 17+ keys Bloodlust goes at 50% (Topicx). If you provide Bloodlust, press Fury of the Aspects at 50% and line up Ebon Might and Breath of Eons on Flamegullet.
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage by knocking it up with Tail Swipe or Upheaval.
[회피] If Flamegullet's Flame Breath (4 sec cast, 96982 Fire in a frontal cone every 0.5 sec) targets you, press Hover and leave the cone while you keep casting.
7: [차단] Take one Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Quell.

[제어] Stop both Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage channels by knocking them up together with Tail Swipe, and if Tail Swipe is on cooldown, fly Breath of Eons through both so Terror of the Skies stuns them for 3 sec.
8: [차단] Take one Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Quell.
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage by knocking it up with Tail Swipe or Upheaval.
[광역 피해] Press Obsidian Scales when Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno DoTs stack up.
10: [광역 피해] Thunderous Stomp (53340 Nature within 60 yds) from six Storm Warriors lands in overlapping waves, so press Zephyr. Apply Ebon Might, then empower Upheaval to rank 3 to launch the grouped Warriors together.

[위치] If Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every sec) targets you, press Obsidian Scales. The Channeler's Thunder Blast only targets the tank, so you do not need to spend Quell on it (Topicx).
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage by knocking it up with Tail Swipe.
11: [차단] The Tempest Channeler kick can be ignored, so use Quell on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt (Topicx).
[위치] If Living Bomb targets you, move more than 6 yds away from the party with Hover. This section is chain-pulled without stopping, so keep casting while you move.
12: [우선 처치] While High Channeler Ryvati's Tempest Stormshield (absorbs 20% of its health) is up, the party takes 29095 Nature every sec, and if it expires unbroken everyone within 60 yds is stunned for 4 sec. Cooldowns go on the shield (Topicx). Refresh Ebon Might and line up Breath of Eons and Upheaval on the shield.
[광역 피해] Press Zephyr while the shield is up, and press Obsidian Scales if Lightning Torrent targets you.
[참고] Some teams use Bloodlust on Ryvati in high keys (Topicx). If your group plans that, press Fury of the Aspects on the first shield.

1: [우선 처치] Kill the Sandfury Stonefist first (Topicx). The Stonefist is immune to crowd control, so apply Ebon Might and fly Breath of Eons (2 min) along a path where the Stonefist and the Sandswept Hunter overlap, leaving Temporal Wound on the Stonefist and stopping the Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel) with the 3 sec Terror of the Skies stun.

[차단] If a Lightning Bolt lands as Ground Pound (4 sec cast, 156627 Physical within 60 yds and a knockback) goes off, players die (Topicx). Take one Storm Adept with Quell (20 sec) and save it for the Lightning Bolt cast during Ground Pound. Take Ground Pound itself with Obsidian Scales (1.5 min, 2 charges with Obsidian Bulwark, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec).
[해제] Free a player hit by Shrouded Fang's Poisoned Cheap Shot (5 sec stun and a 96982 Nature poison every sec) at once with Expunge (8 sec).
2: [해제] The two Shrouded Fangs below the stairs start in stealth. Clear the first Poisoned Cheap Shot poison with Expunge and the second with Cauterizing Flame (1 min).
[차단] Take one Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Quell, and do not miss it during Ground Pound (Topicx).
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage by knocking it up with Tail Swipe (1 min with Clobbering Sweep, 8 yd knock-up) or Upheaval.
4: [우선 처치] If the Sand-Sworn Rider lives long, its Swarming Krolusks rush far-away damage dealers (Topicx). Refresh Ebon Might and put Upheaval and Fire Breath into the Rider.
[차단] Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Quell.
[해제] Clear Poisonous Viper's Cytotoxin (38793 Nature poison every sec for 10 sec) with Expunge.
5: [차단] A Lightning Bolt on a player hit by a Krolusk charge or Cytotoxin kills them (Topicx). Take one of the two Storm Adepts with Quell and do not miss it.
[해제] Clear Cytotoxin with Expunge right away so it never overlaps with a Lightning Bolt.

[참고] The Sand-Sworn Rider is pulled in last once it walks near the top of the bridge (Topicx). When the Rider joins the pack, refresh Ebon Might and fly Breath of Eons where the Rider and the Krolusk Matriarch overlap.
6: [차단] Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind is a 5 sec cast, so one kicker is enough (Topicx). Be that kicker with Quell.
[해제] Free a player hit by Addle Mind (5 sec disorient curse) with Cauterizing Flame, and clear Cytotoxin with Expunge.
7: [해제] Cytotoxin keeps coming from three Poisonous Vipers. Press Expunge on cooldown (8 sec), and if two players are poisoned at once, clear the second with Cauterizing Flame.
[차단] Kick so Venom Bolt never lands on a player with Cytotoxin (Topicx). Take Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Quell.
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage by knocking it up with Tail Swipe or Upheaval.
9: [광역 피해] Release Charge (3 sec cast, 145474 Nature to everyone) from the two Agitated Nimbuses goes off staggered (Topicx). Use Zephyr (2 min) on the first Release Charge and Obsidian Scales on the second.
[차단] Do not let kicks slip while the party takes Release Charge (Topicx). Take Imbued Stormcaller's Lightning Bolt with Quell.

[우선 처치] The Nimbus is tanked on top of the Spark Channeler, and the Channeler dies first to stop the Loose Sparks orbs (Topicx). Apply Ebon Might and put Upheaval around the Channeler so it hits the Nimbus too.
10: [차단] Stop the two Imbued Stormcallers before gathering the other mobs (Topicx). Take one with Quell.
[광역 피해] Press Zephyr for Release Charge, and take it with Obsidian Scales if Zephyr is on cooldown. Topicx says to have a potion or defensive ready for this pull.
[위치] Use Hover to stand apart from other players so the four Static Anomalies' Spark Step (77586 Nature within 5 yds of where it lands) does not overlap.
12: [제어] The Temple Disruptor on the far side of the orb is held with crowd control (Topicx). Put it to sleep with Sleep Walk (1.7 sec cast, 20 sec disorient), and kick the near Disruptor's Essence Disruption channel with Quell.
[광역 피해] Press Zephyr for Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature within 60 yds plus a 10 sec DoT).
[참고] Faithless Conscripts give no count but are gathered into the AoE (Topicx). Refresh Ebon Might and fly Breath of Eons where the Orb Watcher and the Conscripts overlap.
13: [제어] Put the far Temple Disruptor to sleep with Sleep Walk and kick the near one with Quell to protect the orb's charge (Topicx).
[광역 피해] If the Zephyr (2 min) from pull 12 is not back, take Caustic Stomp with Obsidian Scales.
14: [차단] Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire and an 8 sec DoT) must be kicked and the Hexxer is immune to crowd control (Method). Put Quell into the kick rotation.

[제어] The four Faithless Tormentors only chase the healer, so hold them with slows and stuns (Topicx). Drop Landslide (1.5 min, 15 sec root that damage may break) in their path, and if they reach the healer, knock them up with Tail Swipe or fly Breath of Eons through them for a 3 sec stun.
[위치] If Latent Hex targets you, move more than 10 yds away from the party with Hover. When it ends it deals 77586 Shadow within 10 yds and leaves a Hex Muck frog pool.
